description: Land Title Settlement Department - Kambarugamuwa North, Weligama D/S Division, Matara District - Cad. Map No. 820069
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels (including parcel numbers, extents, owner details, and property rights) in the Kamburugamuwa North area. The document is published in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and focuses on land ownership registration, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
